description: Earth's O2 and H2O lines in one spectrum, line by line in f64, through each path of earthLinePaths.json (R08.T4.d's end-to-end test; decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md, its tests), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs earth-reference from the HITRAN2024 lines the k-distributions are reduced from, with the same line shapes and broadening (air-equivalent pressure x r_self + (1 - x) at each layer): each 1 nm cell's mean transmittance per path, in zenithDeg's order (t); and the same with each species homogeneous along the path at its vertical column-weighted temperature and mole fraction and the path's column-weighted (Curtis-Godson) pressure, as the client reads a path (h). The lines are not committed.
